scope: Focused affected backend and UI checks, not the complete repository suite or a structural project certification.
integrated_changes: Versioned RP23 local weak-negative elastic approximation fallback with preserved NBR resistance curves and historical v2 readers.
Versioned full-span Vlasov/Ritz q+P height adapter with authenticated geometry for the 66 documentary-complete Pierin Ue contours.
New-study opt-in, explicit adoption for imported inputs, UI/Word/JSON and cache invalidation.

privacy.QA_cases: Programmatically constructed synthetic fixtures. The app synthetic=false input flag distinguishes catalog profiles from arbitrary synthetic sections; it does not mean project data.
privacy.public_QA_scope: Executable synthetic test generators, summary receipts and logs. Full generated study JSON and Word outputs are excluded from the public release.

limits: RP23 is an explicitly approximate external reference, not a guaranteed lower bound; ri/t=1 is outside the reported calibration sample radii.
Mixed-load Ritz adapter requires Ly=Lz=physical L and fork/free-warping end assumptions; no physical restraint is inferred from effective lengths.
Combined curling and spatial shear lag outside the qualified routes remain pending. No curling research candidate is included in this release.
All 66 weak components observed at fy=250/300/345/350 and L=6000 are a parameter matrix, not all possible load/length/member combinations.
No complete NBR/AISI/EN or whole-member approval is asserted.
